platforms.name: Wix
platforms.summary: Add the glot tag once in Settings → Custom Code, on All pages, placed in Head.

steps: Go to Settings in your site's dashboard.
Under Development & integrations, click Custom Code.
Click + Add Custom Code at the top right.
Paste the glot tag in the text box and give it a name.
Under Add Code to Pages, select All pages and choose Load code on each new page.
Under Place Code in, select Head.
Click Apply, then check the live site.
injection.plans: The site has to be published and have a connected domain, and connecting a domain requires a Premium plan. Snippets are tied to the domain and get deleted if you assign a different domain.

seo.how: Add the CNAME and TXT records at your domain registrar. If the domain was bought from Wix or uses Wix nameservers, use Domains → Domain Actions → Manage DNS records → + Add Record instead. This is not possible on a wixsite.com address.

faq.q: Why is Custom Code missing or greyed out?
faq.a: Wix only allows custom code on a published site with a connected domain, and connecting a domain requires a Premium plan.

faq.q: My DNS records are not in Wix. Where do I add them?
faq.a: If the domain is connected to Wix by pointing, or uses custom nameservers, Wix says to manage DNS records with your DNS provider or domain host.

docs.label: Wix: Embedding custom code on your site
Wix: Managing DNS records in your Wix account

platforms.notes: The Premium-plan requirement for connecting a domain comes from Wix search snippets (Connecting a domain / About domains articles), not from a page I fetched. In December 2025 Wix added frontend security measures for custom code that can block some snippets, so test the tag on the live site.

In glot, open your project → Integrations → Shopify and paste the domain and the token. Add the API secret key too if you want glot to register and verify webhooks.

Either install a plugin that lets you add custom code (for example Code Snippets), or create a child theme.
In the child theme's functions.php (or a new snippet), hook a function on wp_head that echoes the glot tag.
Save or activate the snippet and clear any caching plugin.
Open your store in a private window and check that the language menu appears.
injection.plans: WooCommerce is self-hosted and free; any WordPress install where you can add plugins or edit a child theme can add the tag. On managed WordPress.com, plugins require a plan that allows them.

seo.how: Add the CNAME and TXT wherever your domain's DNS is hosted (registrar, hosting provider or DNS service). You control your own domain on a self-hosted store.

faq.q: Should I paste the tag in the theme editor's header.php?
faq.a: Not in the parent theme: an update erases it. WooCommerce's docs recommend a child theme's functions.php or a code-snippets plugin.

faq.q: Does it work on the block checkout and cart?
faq.a: The tag runs on every page that prints wp_head, including cart and checkout pages of standard themes.

platforms.notes: WooCommerce docs confirm the child theme / Code Snippets approach but do not mention wp_head; the wp_head hook is standard WordPress, not taken from a fetched WooCommerce page. WordPress.com plan detail not fetched.

steps: Download glot.zip (built from integrations/wordpress-plugin in the glot repository; it isn't on WordPress.org yet). It needs WordPress 6.1+ and PHP 7.4+.
In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, upload glot.zip and activate it.

Open Settings → glot and enter your project slug, your public key (pk_…, never a secret glot_… key), the source language and your languages, then save. The plugin adds glot.js to every front-end page.
Optional: place the language switcher with the [glot_switcher] shortcode, the glot language switcher widget or block, or the Elementor widget; otherwise it sits in the corner you picked.
WooCommerce: cart, checkout and account forms are never read; customer details on order and address pages are marked so they are never translated or reported.
Optional: for translated URLs, set up glot Edge (subdomain or subdirectory) and choose it as the SEO mode, so the plugin adds hreflang links to the Edge pages.
